complaint_text: There is a large pothole in front of the school gate and it is causing accidents for cyclists and pedestrians.
Garbage has been piling up near the bus stop for three days and the area smells badly.
The streetlight near the park entrance has been broken for over a week and the road is dark at night.
A water pipe is leaking in front of the apartment block and water is flowing onto the road.
The storm drain near the market is clogged and sewage is overflowing onto the pavement.
The electricity pole near the intersection is sparking and the area is unsafe for pedestrians.
A large tree has fallen across the road after the storm and traffic is blocked.
Floodwater is entering homes near the low-lying lane after the heavy rain.
There is illegal dumping of construction debris behind the vacant lot and it attracts pests.
The traffic signal at the main junction is not working and vehicles are creating chaos during peak hours.
Potholes on the service road are making it difficult for ambulances to pass safely.
Overflowing bins outside the market are attracting stray dogs and spreading litter.
One of the street lights near the railway crossing has been out for several nights.
Water is leaking from a burst pipe near the school and flooding the footpath.
The open drain is blocked by plastic waste and water is backing up on the road.
A transformer box is overheating near the housing colony and residents are worried.
A tree branch has broken and fallen onto the overhead cable near the roadside.
The low-lying market road is flooded even after a short period of rain.
Construction waste is being dumped along the roadside near the industrial area.
The traffic signal at the hospital junction changes too slowly and causes congestion.
